statics.（帽子を押さえて、階段を上がっていった）: (Holding the hat down, climbs the stairs.)

statics.（前と同じ暗がりで、前と同じように待っていた）: (Waiting in the same dark as before, the same way as before.)

statics.彼女も、その席に座ってた。: She sat in that seat, too.

statics.カップを片づけてくれるかい。: Would you clear the cup away?
statics.誰を待ってたのか、思い出せなくなった。: I can't remember who I was waiting for anymore.

statics.「深く掘っても、わたしはいない」。そう書いてあった。: “Dig as deep as you like, I won't be there.” That's what it said.

statics.痛いのは、どっちだろうね。: I wonder which of us it hurts.
